Chronicle Books was founded in 1967 during the Summer of Love, when San Francisco was the capital of renegade publishing. In the four decades since, the company has grown into an international publisher with a signature style recognized around the globe. Today Chronicle Books publishes more than 300 books and stationery products each year for children and adults, in print and digital formats, and many titles hit the bestseller lists regularly.
